title: Authorization: method + target filtering
description: Acceptance: filter by method and target
close_reason: Needs design decision: No spec defines method+target filtering policy. Current proxy validates mesh URIs (SSRF protection) but no spec specifies which methods/paths to restrict. Requires design decisions: 1) Which methods allowed (GET-only? PUT?), 2) Which target paths filtered, 3) Authorization model (ACL, whitelist, role-based), 4) Configuration mechanism. Reopen with design spec.
